# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability

Don't report security problems in public issues or discussions. Report them privately with [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/leikoilja/ha-google-home/security/advisories/new) on the repository's **Security** tab. Your report stays private. The maintainers can invite others to help fix it.

Include the affected versions, what an attacker could do, and how to reproduce it.
